# apps/web/src/components/ui — shadcn/ui Components

Auto-generated by `npx shadcn@latest add <component>`. Do not edit manually.

**Belongs here:** shadcn/ui component files generated by the CLI.
**Must NOT go here:** Custom business components (→ `features/`), or hand-written wrappers.
This folder is intentionally empty until shadcn is wired up.
